name: Sinolink Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Sinolink Securities Co., Ltd. provides investment banking and securities brokerage services in China. The company operates through five business segments: Wealth Management Business, Investment Banking Business, Institutional Services Business, Asset Business, and Proprietary Trading. The company offers commission treasure, research consulting, fixed income, national gold index, investment bank, market making trading, and over-the-counter market services. It also involved in the provision of agree to buy back, asset custody, stock option, Hong Kong stock connect, margin trading, and stock pledge services; and derivatives business.
